entities.summary: Daniel Niklas Bång is a Swedish former professional ice hockey Right wing. He played 8 NHL games with the Nashville Predators but spend most of the 2012/13 season with their American Hockey League (AHL) affiliate the Milwaukee Admirals. He played as a youth with Kista HC and AIK.
